answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. What this achieves is a system where the cost of an attack is public and provable, so the whole network can trust verdicts without trusting any single identity.
